info.name: Kubernetes Services Kubernetes EndpointSlices NetworkPolicy API
Kubernetes Services List NetworkPolicies in a namespace

params.name: namespace
params.description: Namespace name to scope the request.

params.name: labelSelector
params.description: Label selector to filter resources.

params.name: fieldSelector
params.description: Field selector to filter resources by field values.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return.

params.name: continue
params.description: Pagination continuation token.

params.name: watch
params.description: If true, stream watch events instead of returning a list.

items.docs: Returns a list of all NetworkPolicy objects in the specified namespace. Network policies are enforced by the CNI plugin and define which pods can send or receive network traffic.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Namespace name to scope the request.

params.name: dryRun
params.description: If 'All', validates without persisting the change.

items.docs: Creates a new NetworkPolicy in the specified namespace. Once created, the CNI plugin enforces the policy by allowing only the traffic explicitly permitted by ingress and egress rules.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Namespace name to scope the request.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the NetworkPolicy resource.

items.docs: Returns the specified NetworkPolicy including its pod selector, ingress rules, egress rules, and policy types (Ingress, Egress, or both).

params.name: namespace
params.description: Namespace name to scope the request.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the NetworkPolicy resource.

params.name: dryRun
params.description: If 'All', validates without persisting the change.

items.docs: Replaces the full specification of the specified NetworkPolicy. The CNI plugin re-evaluates the updated rules immediately for all pods selected by the policy.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Namespace name to scope the request.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the NetworkPolicy resource.

items.docs: Applies a partial update to the specified NetworkPolicy using strategic merge patch. Useful for adding or removing individual ingress or egress rules.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Namespace name to scope the request.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the NetworkPolicy resource.

items.docs: Deletes the specified NetworkPolicy. Traffic previously restricted by this policy will no longer be affected once the policy is removed.

info.name: Kubernetes Services List NetworkPolicies across all namespaces

params.name: labelSelector
params.description: Label selector to filter resources.

params.name: fieldSelector
params.description: Field selector to filter resources by field values.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return.

params.name: watch
params.description: If true, stream watch events instead of returning a list.

items.docs: Returns all NetworkPolicy objects across every namespace in the cluster. Useful for auditing network segmentation, identifying gaps in policy coverage, and reviewing cross-namespace traffic restrictions.
